div.div:
Notes
*1 Both complete within one site; no FlexCache fan-out
This architecture is for consumers that sit elsewhere and cannot be moved
*2 Protocol coverage narrows the choice before cost does
A serves NFS v3 / v4.x and SMB. B serves NFS v4.1 and v4.2 only; NFSv3 and SMB are out of scope
*3 The source of truth sits in different places
A: the FSx for ONTAP volume. B: the S3 bucket, unchanged
*4 B requires consumers on AWS compute
Amazon EC2, AWS Lambda, Amazon EKS, Amazon ECS, with a mount helper
